name: smwmusic-piranhan-bgm-jingle
title: Piranhan - BGM Jingle 1
description:
A small fanfare used when you kills all of the piranhas in an obscure game co-created by Pixel in Unity.
Standalone version using SMW samples only. A goal whistle version is included, in case you want to use it as a goal song. If you want to use that version, open the text file, and change the "Goal_Whistle" define value to anything, other than 0.

Mod note: Will not work as a global song by default unless you ensure that the loaded sample group includes @21.
